description: Synthetic evidence for the WorkplaceMeetingPrep scenario's Replay mode. Fictional client, people, and dates; the text mirrors data/workplace/corpus-seed.md. Not a capture of any Microsoft 365 content. Each item states its business date in its text, and that is the only chronology. The receivedAt values are synthetic transport times, all on one seeding day as in a seeded mailbox, so they cannot stand in for it.

items.title: [NW-DPM] Kickoff notes
items.author: Priya Raman
items.text:
Kickoff notes, September 22, 2026.
Attendees: Dana Okafor (Northwind sponsor), Priya Raman, Marcus Lindqvist.
Planned pilot go-live: November 2, 2026.

items.title: [NW-DPM] Steering committee recap
items.author: Priya Raman
items.text:
Steering committee recap, September 29, 2026.
Decision: the pilot scope is limited to the finance data mart. The steering committee agreed and Dana Okafor confirmed it.

items.title: [NW-DPM] Security review summary
items.author: Priya Raman
items.text:
September 30, 2026.
Action: Priya Raman will deliver the security review summary by October 9, 2026. It has not been delivered yet.

items.title: [NW-DPM] ERP extract issue
items.author: Priya Raman
items.text:
September 30, 2026.
Priya Raman raised a risk: the source ERP extract is missing ledger mappings for two business units. Nobody has been assigned to resolve it.

items.title: [NW-DPM] Go-live date change approved
items.author: Dana Okafor
items.text:
October 1, 2026.
Dana Okafor approved moving the pilot go-live from November 2 to November 16, 2026. This replaces the date in the kickoff notes.

items.title: [NW-DPM] Sandbox access request
items.author: Marcus Lindqvist
items.text:
October 1, 2026.
Marcus Lindqvist confirmed the sandbox access request is complete. All four team members can sign in.
